g.text: Three transaction rows per stage, not two: the magazine
debit, the writer payout, and the platform fee. The fee
row is invisible to both balance invariants, so it adds
amount is always positive; direction comes from type
plus the from/to user, enforced by a CHECK constraint.
A marketplace article is in one of three states, and
publisherId is what tells them apart:
listed — no full purchase, publisherId NULL;
owned — a full_purchase row, still not public;
published — placement public, visibility free, price
cleared, publisherId set to the buying magazine.
